tillHealth.title: Till health
tillHealth.capacity: Changes are building up. Open Till health.
tillHealth.closeoutHint: Close the day when service ends.

noShift.detail: Start a shift to take orders.

issue.title: Something needs your attention
issue.detail: See below what needs attention and what you can do.

working.title: Saving now
working.detail: You can carry on working while the till finishes.

pending.title: Waiting for confirmation
pending.detail: The till is still checking the result. You can keep working.

support.title: Support is needed
support.detail: See what is affected below. Ask The Small for help.

offline.title: The till is working offline
offline.detail: Orders stay on this till and are sent when the connection returns.

unavailable.detail: We could not check this till. Check again in a moment.

action.noSafeAction: This needs to be checked by support.
action.noLongerNeeded: The change is no longer needed
action.keepDetails: Keep the details as they are
action.keepExplanation: The order keeps the details you see now and the case is closed.
action.offline: This action needs an internet connection.
action.sendFailed: The changes could not be sent.

phase.failed: The change could not be completed.
phase.busy: The till was busy with another task. Press again in a moment.
phase.signIn: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in to the till again.
phase.shift: A cashier or manager needs an active shift on this till.
phase.permission: Ask the manager to check this.
phase.grant: The approval expired. Press again to confirm.
phase.parked: This change needs someone from support.
phase.correctionWorking: The customer details are being saved
phase.correctionPending: The change to the customer details is awaiting confirmation
phase.correctionKept: The customer details were kept as they were

help.title: Need help?
help.available: The Small can connect to this till. You will see a code to give them.
help.unavailable: Remote support could not start. Ask the manager to arrange a visit from support. A report can still be saved.
help.offline: The Small can connect when the internet is back. You can save a report now.
help.permission: Ask the manager to request a connection. You can still prepare a report.

support.title: For support
support.hint: Only if support asks you to open it

orderItems.resolved_one: The printing of a platform order waited for its items. The till fetched them by itself and printing went ahead.
orderItems.resolved_other: The printing of {{count}} platform orders waited for their items. The till fetched them by itself and printing went ahead.
orderItems.pending: The printing of a platform order is waiting for its items. The till is fetching them by itself.
orderItems.failed: The items of a platform order were late reaching the till. If one of its slips did not print, open the order and print it again.
orderItems.unknown: The till asked for the items of a platform order so it could print it. We do not know whether it got them.

platformCash.recorded_one: A cash platform order was assigned to one of the store’s drivers. The till recorded the cash under that driver’s shift.
platformCash.recorded_other: {{count}} cash platform orders were assigned to the store’s drivers. The till recorded the cash under each driver’s shift.

paymentMethod.recorded: The payment method of a payment was changed. Nothing was charged again.

report.none: No report has been sent yet.
report.sent: The report reached The Small and a copy is saved here ({{time}}).
report.automatic: Sent automatically at {{time}}. The Small received the report.
report.local: Saved only on this till at {{time}}. The report was not sent.
report.explanation: The report is saved on this till. With a connection it is also sent to The Small.
report.noCopies: There are no saved copies yet.
report.openCopy: Open the folder for the copy from {{date}}
report.waiting: The report is saved on this till. It will be sent when the connection returns.
report.sendFailed: The report is saved here. Delivery couldn’t be confirmed.
report.historyUnavailable: The saved reports could not be read.
report.pending: The report is saved on this till. It hasn’t been sent yet.

customerCorrection.title: The change to the customer details was not saved
customerCorrection.detail: The order still has the previous details. The sale and payment are unaffected.

connection.title: The till is no longer linked to the store
connection.detail: The manager can link the till again from the connection settings.

invalidOrders.title: Some orders contain items the till does not recognise
invalidOrders.detail: The manager needs to check those orders.

order.title: A change to the order was not saved
order.detail: Check the order as it appears on this till before making any further changes.

wrongMoney.title: The payment and the order total differ
wrongMoney.detail: Do not charge the customer again. Ask the manager to check the amounts.

driver.title: The driver assignment was not saved
driver.detail: Check who is taking this order.

orderPaymentWait.title: A change to the order did not complete
orderPaymentWait.detail: The payment is waiting for that change. Do not charge the customer again.

orderWaiting.title: The change is waiting for the original order
orderWaiting.detail: The till is looking for the order before it saves the change.

orderMissing.title: The original order could not be found
orderMissing.detail: The change needs to be checked before it can be saved.

catalog.title: The item’s availability did not update on other tills
catalog.detail: Check what is still available before accepting an order for this item.

address.title: The new address was not set as the main one
address.detail: This does not affect the order.

customerDuplicate.title: A customer with the same phone number already exists
customerDuplicate.detail: Check whether this is the same person.

customerPhone.title: The customer’s phone number needs correcting
customerPhone.detail: The order and day close are unaffected.

customerDirectory.title: The new customer details stayed on this till
customerDirectory.detail: The changes may not appear on other tills.

shiftClosed.title: The shift closed on another till
shiftClosed.detail: Ask the manager to check the figures. Do not repeat a payment or refund.

oldOrderCorrection.title: An older order correction did not complete
oldOrderCorrection.detail: The manager compares the order with the receipt before closing the day.

phoneShifts.title: Day close is waiting for phone shifts
phoneShifts.detail: Close the shift on the phone or in Staff. The day close will then be sent automatically.

uncertainPayment.title: The card payment has not been confirmed
uncertainPayment.detail: Check the bank’s card terminal. Do not charge the customer again.

platform.title: The platform’s payment needs checking
platform.detail: The platform collected the payment. Do not collect it again at the till.

balance.title: The order has an outstanding balance
balance.detail: Open the payment to review what is owed.

payment.title: A payment entry needs checking
payment.detail: Do not repeat a charge or refund.

paymentWaiting.title: The payment is waiting for the order
paymentWaiting.detail: The payment is recorded here. Do not charge again.

refundWaiting.title: The refund is waiting for the original payment
refundWaiting.detail: Do not enter the refund or cancellation a second time.

refundMissing.title: The original payment for this refund could not be found
refundMissing.detail: Ask support to check the payment before making another change.

oldPayments.title: Older payments need checking
oldPayments.detail: The manager needs to check the payment history.

courierMoney.title: The cash payment and the driver’s entry differ
courierMoney.detail: Ask the manager to check the driver’s shift.

courierCheck.title: The driver’s cash could not be checked
courierCheck.detail: The manager needs to check this shift.

printerSetting.title: The printer did not recognise its receipt setting
printerSetting.detail: Restore the last setting and check a test receipt.

printer.title: The printer needs attention
printer.detail: Orders still save on the till. Check the paper, power and connection.

waiting.title: Some changes are waiting to be sent
waiting.detail: The changes are saved on this till.
waiting.stuck: Changes waiting to be sent: {{count}}. The longest wait is {{duration}}.

printing.title: Receipts are not printing
printing.detail: Receipts waiting: {{count}}. Check the paper, power and connection.

sending.title: Some changes could not be sent
sending.detail: They remain on this till and need to be checked before they can be sent.

orderCheck.title: The till could not check the order
orderCheck.detail: It stays in the active orders. Check again in a moment.

dayClose.title: The day close needs checking
dayClose.detail: Check the day’s orders and payments before closing.

dayOverdue.title: The day is still open
dayOverdue.detail: Close the day when service ends.

fiscal.title: Some receipts have not reached the tax service
fiscal.detail: The day close is waiting for those receipts.

crash.title: The till closed unexpectedly
crash.detail: Check the last order before entering it again.
